def solve(inp):

    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==3][0]
    r0,c0=seed

        seg=2*(i//2+1)

        dr,dc=DIRS[dch]
        plan=[]; abort=False
        rr,cc=r,c
        for _ in range(seg):
